# Matrixgame repository map for language models

This repository is a changing collection of prototypes, proposals, research notes, and historical material, not one completed simulator. Read source files before making claims. See [Start here](00_START_HERE.md), the [documentation index](docs/INDEX.md), and the [AI reading guide](docs/AI_READING_GUIDE.md).

## Entry points

- [Architecture Standard](docs/ARCHITECTURE_STANDARD.md): module boundaries, artifact metadata, versioning, statuses, and minimum quality gates.
- [Artifact Envelope schema](matrixgame-protocol/artifact-envelope.schema.json): shared metadata contract; domain-specific payloads retain their own schemas.
- [Responsible Gamification Standard](docs/RESPONSIBLE_GAMIFICATION_STANDARD.md): autonomy, competence, relatedness, honest feedback, and recovery without pressure.
- [Quest schema](matrixgame-protocol/quest.schema.json): versioned, non-coercive quest definition; personal run data stays separate.

- [README](README.md): project status and direction.
- [Documentation index](docs/INDEX.md): selected topic map.
- [Universal Knowledge Engine](docs/UNIVERSAL_KNOWLEDGE_ENGINE.md): proposed knowledge/evidence architecture.
- [Knowledge Node and Evidence Schema](docs/KNOWLEDGE_NODE_AND_EVIDENCE_SCHEMA.md): structured claim and evidence model.
- [Collective Improvement Network](docs/COLLECTIVE_IMPROVEMENT_NETWORK.md): collaboration vision and roadmap.
- [Learning Quests](docs/LEARNING_QUESTS_AND_GAMIFICATION.md): proposed learning mechanics.
- [Game protocol](matrixgame-protocol/README.md): local prototype and deployment cautions.

## Selected artifacts

- [Emotion Regulation and Goal Alignment](docs/EMOTION_REGULATION_AND_GOAL_ALIGNMENT_2026-11-25.md): evidence-informed self-regulation, flexible response options, values-aligned action, recovery and privacy boundaries.
- [Optional emotion-regulation quest template](matrixgame-protocol/quest.emotion-regulation.example.json): uses the existing Quest schema; does not require personal emotional data.


- [Human Flourishing framework](docs/HUMAN_FLOURISHING_FRAMEWORK_2026-11-25.md): research-aligned domains, agency, enabling conditions, and responsible measurement.
- [Energy and Resource Optimization](research/MATRIXGAME_ENERGY_AND_RESOURCE_OPTIMIZATION_2026-11-25.md): global energy transition snapshot, units, access, efficiency, resilience, and Second Earth model path.
- [Structured global energy snapshot](research/MATRIXGAME_ENERGY_AND_RESOURCE_OPTIMIZATION_2026-11-25.json): 13 source-linked observations, estimates and scenarios with caveats.


- [Social connection and safety research snapshot](research/MATRIXGAME_SOCIAL_CONNECTION_AND_SAFETY_2026-11-25.md): dated evidence-aware synthesis of violence, under-reporting, relationships and living arrangements.
- [Structured social connection and safety data](research/MATRIXGAME_SOCIAL_CONNECTION_AND_SAFETY_2026-11-25.json): source-linked metrics; do not merge unlike statistical measures.

- [Java Boulder Dash](MatrixgameBoulderDash.java): standalone grid-game prototype; inspect source for actual behavior.
- [Python model](modellierung_des_kollektiven_bewusstseins.py): notebook-derived example; assumptions are not automatically validated.
- [Physics A–Z Atlas](docs/PHYSICS_AZ_ATLAS.md): physics reference structure.
- [Historical concept and transcript](Matrixgam%20und%20Kollektives%20Bewusstsein%20und%20KI-Game12.11.2026.md): source history, not a canonical specification.

## Handling

Distinguish implementation, tests, proposals, observations, hypotheses, metaphors, and fiction. Do not present game scores or speculative claims as validated findings. Do not repeat personal/contact/payment or sensitive health details from historical files. Keep sharing voluntary; verify scientific and medical claims against reliable sources.
